summary: PowerBank Corporation (Nasdaq: PBK) announced through its US subsidiary Abundant Solar Power Inc. the acquisition of two New York community solar projects, Highway 28 (6.9 MW) and Gainesville (7 MW), via repurchase agreements. Total purchase price for both is US$2,396,068, payable in milestone payments. Highway 28 costs US$1,249,488 and Gainesville US$1,146,580. Combined construction value is ~US$32.5 million with expected US federal tax credits of ~US$13 million. The projects are expected to be construction-ready in 2026 and 2027, respectively. Highway 28 has secured permits and NYSERDA incentives; Gainesville is in permitting and involved in litigation. Watch for construction milestones and litigation outcome affecting Gainesville.
